messages:
jade: Heads-up — opened PR to refresh the Quickstart 'hello-run' onboarding. Main asks: add a VPC/private auth snippet, a minimal service-account flow, and a Docker container recipe for on-prem customers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5432

sam: Nice! Can we include a local-dev fallback (tokenless dev flow) so new devs can spin up the hello app without KMS?

mike: I can add the service-account + fallback. Minimal bash example to run locally: 
```bash
# local dev (loads SA key file if present, otherwise starts in dev mode)
if [ -f ./sa-key.json ]; then
  export REDWOOD_SA_KEY=$(cat sa-key.json)
  ./hello --auth service-account
else
  ./hello --auth dev-fallback
fi
```

natalie: prefer not to encourage pasting raw key material in docs. can we demonstrate using a temporary file and point to the KMS integration guide for production? also add a security note about least privilege.

mike: good call. i'll replace the env-var example with this python client snippet + comment pointing to KMS: 
```python
from redwood import Client
# load from a keyfile stored in a secure path (e.g. /run/secrets/redwood_sa)
client = Client.from_service_account('/run/secrets/redwood_sa')
resp = client.generate('Hello world')
print(resp.text)
```

jade: great. next: a small Dockerfile + systemd hint for private deployments. keep it minimal so we don't get sucked into full ops docs. container should bind to 127.0.0.1 and read creds from /run/secrets.

natalie: Dockerfile suggestion below — please keep comments brief.
```dockerfile
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
COPY hello.py .
# expect /run/secrets/redwood_sa to be mounted by the orchestrator
ENV REDWOOD_SA_PATH=/run/secrets/redwood_sa
CMD ["python", "hello.py"]
```

sam: i'll do a sanity pass on the prose — minor nits: add a KMS link, call out key rotation + audit logging, and a 1-line caveat about private-binary sizes.

docs-bot: PR 5432 — docs build: success. spellcheck: 2 warnings (suggested: "runbook" -> "runbook"), broken links: 0.

ci-bot: Deploy preview available: https://deploy-preview-5432--redwood-docs.netlify.app/hello-run (preview expires in 7 days) :rocket:

jade: tagging @eng-runtime for a short note about model selection on small private GPUs — they asked to include a memory/cpu caveat.

lina: lina: quick suggestion — for private deployments on small GPUs, prefer model variant `redwood-small` and set `max_tokens` to 512 in the examples to reduce OOM risk. adding that to the bottom of the quickstart is fine.

mike: added lina's line and a one-sentence KMS pointer. any objections to me squashing the branch into one commit before merge?

natalie: i can squash and merge after sam's review. target is to merge today so engineering can point new customers at the preview.

sam: reviewing now, will comment within 30 minutes.

jade: thanks all — appreciate the quick turn. i'll update the PR description to call out the new Docker snippet + SA flow and shipnotes for the docs changelog.
